assessments.rationale: Pinned benchmark task-mask hub initialization was inspected. The previous declared adaptation executed successfully but UF lost click relative to UU, and FF lost click relative to FU. Forward task awareness alone did not yield the hoped-for compromise. This study inherits the local UF views and tests backward parameter ownership; no evidence yet confirms an INFNet mechanism or gradient conflict.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: Extend fixed click-uniform/auxiliary-feedback access with independently gated auxiliary updates into shared scorer and embeddings; no task hubs, private projections or additional learned capacity.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: Backward ownership under an identical compressed forward operator, rather than layerwise task hubs and gated broadcasts. Pinned reimplementation and benchmark fallback inspected; original INFNet paper detail unavailable. Multi-task stop-gradient novelty is unverified.
assessments.falsifier: No click recovery versus open_grad, failed operator/gradient parity, or loss of auxiliary retention leaves this proposed compromise unsupported.
